biography: Bruno Sutter grew up in the Vila Velha favela of Espírito Santo, Brazil, where the roar of modified engines was the soundtrack to his life. He wasn't born into racing royalty; his father was a mechanic, and his mother sold acarajé on the beach. Bruno's first taste of speed came from tearing around the narrow, dusty streets on a beat-up scooter his father had salvaged. He entered his first Copa Fusca race at 19, borrowing his uncle's '72 Beetle, and astonishing everyone by finishing third despite starting last after a qualifying mishap involving a stray dog and a hastily repaired tie rod. His aggressive style, honed on those unforgiving favela streets, quickly made him a fan favorite, but also earned him a few enemies. Currently, Bruno is aiming to secure sponsorship to move into a more competitive GT series, leveraging his Copa Fusca success as a stepping stone. The dream is to one day race at Interlagos in a car that isn't older than he is.
drivingStyle: Bruno's driving style is characterized by relentless aggression and a daring approach to corners. He's a late-braking specialist, often diving into gaps that others wouldn't even consider. Tire management isn't his strongest suit; he tends to push hard from the start, sacrificing longevity for early gains. Under pressure, Bruno becomes even more assertive, sometimes to a fault, occasionally resulting in costly mistakes. He thrives on close racing and isn't afraid to trade paint, making him both exciting and controversial on the track.

rivalries.name: Ricardo 'The Professor' Albuquerque
rivalries.reason: A veteran Copa Fusca driver who openly criticizes Bruno's aggressive tactics, leading to several on-track clashes and heated post-race interviews.

rivalries.name: Isabela 'Ice' Oliveira
rivalries.reason: A young, technically gifted driver who consistently outperforms Bruno in qualifying, forcing him to make risky maneuvers to overtake her during races.

rivalries.name: Marco 'The Wall' Ferreira
rivalries.reason: Known for his defensive driving style and ability to block overtaking attempts, which often frustrates Bruno and leads to aggressive overtaking attempts ending in contact.

quirks: Always wears a faded Senna t-shirt under his racing suit.
Listens to a specific samba track by Cartola moments before the race starts.
Taps the roof of his car three times before getting in, a ritual passed down from his grandfather who used to drive trucks.
famousQuote: "I don't race for second place. Second place is just the first loser."
careerHighlight: Winning the Copa Fusca Championship in 2022 after a season-long battle with Ricardo Albuquerque. He secured the title in the final race with a daring last-lap overtake that left Albuquerque spinning in the gravel.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the 2021 Copa Fusca season finale while leading, costing him the championship. A mechanical failure was suspected, but Bruno blamed himself for pushing the car too hard.
